body: Magandang signal, pero may human trap sa good-news cycle: kapag booming ang isang technical niche, madaling i-convert ang market demand into personal identity—'valuable ako because scarce ang skill ko.' Then kapag cycle turns, parang self-worth din ang bumagsak. Better question for engineers: ginagamit ba natin ang strong demand para mag-build ng transferable competence, o para lang ma-confirm na tama ang current specialization natin? Industrial cycles reward skill, but they can also flatter us into overconfidence.
